source_snapshot.procedure: Boot the host OS, load the GPU driver, stress the module, and use `ipmitool sdr elist` to observe sensor changes.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal power-sensor change, settings that match SPEC, correct shutdown or fan-speed behavior at threshold, and PASS for all PWR_GB_GPU1_M through PWR_GB_GPU8_M.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek treats unspecified raw IPMI bytes as mandatory even though the source explicitly identifies a standard read-only SDR command; it does correctly leave the platform-specific acceptance values unresolved.

original_test_intent.purpose: Validate that every PWR_GB_GPU1_M through PWR_GB_GPU8_M BMC power sensor responds to an approved GPU load and that any configured threshold produces the platform-specified fan, throttle, shutdown and event behavior.
original_test_intent.target: All eight named `_M` GPU-board power sensors, each mapped to its physical GPU/module/slot and independently correlated with host-side GPU telemetry or another qualified power reference.
original_test_intent.scope: Capture each sensor's SDR identity, units, scaling, thresholds and baseline; run the owner-approved bounded GPU workload; correlate the eight BMC readings with per-GPU/module telemetry; observe only authorized threshold behavior; then stop the load and verify return to baseline, event deassertion and system/GPU health.
original_test_intent.operation: Freeze the `_M` definition and eight-sensor map, record BMC/GPU/software baselines, obtain the workload and power-protection approval, start synchronized BMC and GPU telemetry, apply the bounded workload, observe the rise/steady-state/fall of every applicable sensor and any specified response, abort on signed limits, then preserve evidence and recover the system.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One independently attributable load-and-recovery observation for each of the eight named sensors. The source gives a 10-minute machine-time estimate but no load duration or sampling interval; those values must come from the qualified workload contract and must not be invented.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Each applicable sensor is present, maps to the correct GPU/module, reports the specified unit and plausible value, changes in the expected direction and tolerance under load, produces only the documented event/protection response at an authorized threshold, and returns to the approved range without GPU, driver, host or BMC fault.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Signed `_M` definition and eight-sensor map; SDR record numbers/types/units/scaling/thresholds; GPU/module identity and BDF/UUID; driver/runtime/workload versions; synchronized BMC and per-GPU/module power, temperature, clocks, throttling, fan and host logs; workload timing; threshold/event response; recovery and final health.
ambiguities: The `_M` suffix and its distinction from the adjacent PWR_GB_GPU1~GPU8 sensor set are not defined.
No wattage range, scaling, tolerance, load profile, sample rate, duration, threshold, hysteresis or expected response is supplied.
The source says `stress the module` without identifying the GPU vendor, workload, device selection or power envelope.
The criterion's `shutdown or change fan speed` does not state whether an active threshold crossing is required, which threshold applies or whether throttling is the expected response.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly preserves the distinct `_M` sensor set and demands mapping, power limits, workload, independent monitoring, protection behavior and recovery. It overstates missing provisionable inputs as a permanent capability block and incorrectly requires raw IPMI bytes despite the source's explicit read-only `ipmitool sdr elist` path.

applicable_history.decision: The historical PARTIAL decision recognizes an operator-supplied contract but repeats the unsupported raw-command premise and supplies no eight-channel evidence model.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION. Read-only SDR and host GPU telemetry can be automated now; the active load and any protection-threshold exercise remain prohibited until the eight-sensor mapping, `_M` semantics, platform power specification and approved workload/recovery contract are supplied.

available_now: `ipmitool sdr elist` can enumerate and read supported SDR sensors without inventing raw bytes.

On a supported NVIDIA platform, documented `nvidia-smi` power queries can provide a host-side correlation source after the exact GPU-to-sensor map is established; a different vendor requires its qualified equivalent.
Static BMC/GPU identity, baseline telemetry, SDR metadata and existing SEL/host logs can be collected before active loading.
missing_inputs: Authoritative meaning of `_M` and one-to-one PWR_GB_GPU1_M~GPU8_M to GPU/module/slot/BDF/UUID mapping, including absent-device applicability
Per-sensor units, scaling, normal range, tolerance, sample cadence, thresholds/hysteresis and exact event/fan/throttle/shutdown expectations
GPU-vendor-specific driver/runtime, approved workload and device selector with load duration, maximum board/module/system power and concurrent-versus-sequential rule
Independent monitoring, maintenance approval, human abort authority, evidence retention and recovery criteria after throttle/shutdown or telemetry loss
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BMC/platform owner supplies `_M`, mapping and sensor/event specifications; the GPU/workload owner supplies the supported driver, telemetry semantics and bounded workload; the power/thermal and lab owners approve limits, protection transitions, monitoring and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect full SDR inventory/readings and unmodified SEL with BMC/firmware identity, protected credentials and timestamps.
Collect GPU inventory, UUID/BDF and supported read-only power/temperature/clock/throttle fields; report correlations as unverified until the signed sensor map exists.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not run the GPU stress, intentionally cross a power/protection threshold, change power limits/fans/thresholds, issue guessed raw IPMI, clear SEL or trigger a shutdown before approval.
Do not assume sensor order equals GPU order, substitute aggregate chassis power, treat an unsupported/zero reading as valid, or declare PASS from a static SDR snapshot.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Every named sensor has an approved physical and host-telemetry mapping; baseline units/scaling are plausible; the workload's target, duration and power envelope are signed; expected threshold/event/protection behavior and abort/recovery are explicit; a dry-run proves synchronized evidence capture without altering controls.

revision_candidate.test_name: GPU Board Power `_M` Sensors 1–8 Load-Response Validation
revision_candidate.purpose: Validate the load response, configured thresholds and documented protection/event behavior of every PWR_GB_GPU1_M–PWR_GB_GPU8_M sensor under an approved bounded GPU workload.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact GPU server recipe whose BMC exposes these eight `_M` sensors, with the vendor-supported host GPU driver/runtime, a signed sensor-to-GPU/module map, qualified workload, synchronized BMC/host monitoring and recovery access.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All eight named sensors individually, mapped to physical GPU/module/slot and BDF/UUID; absent or unsupported channels require an owner-approved NOT_APPLICABLE result rather than omission.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: `_M` definition; eight-channel mapping; SDR units/scaling/normal range/tolerance/thresholds/hysteresis/event map; GPU stack and bounded workload; target/duration/sample cadence/power limits; expected fan/throttle/shutdown behavior; approvals; abort, logging and recovery plan.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture SDR, SEL, GPU identity and synchronized power/thermal/clock/throttle baselines. After approval, run the qualified workload only on the mapped target/schedule while recording every BMC and host-side channel; verify the specified rise, steady-state, event/protection response and fall; stop within signed limits, then prove recovery and preserve evidence. Repeat until every applicable sensor has an independent result.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct platform recipe; `_M` and all mappings resolved; plausible read-only baselines; supported GPU driver/runtime and telemetry; workload target and power envelope qualified; thresholds/protection behavior specified; no conflicting load; monitoring, maintenance window, abort, log capacity and recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed eight-channel matrix; raw SDR records/readings/thresholds; GPU UUID/BDF/module identity; driver/runtime/workload versions; synchronized per-channel BMC and host power plus temperature/clock/throttle/fan/host data; workload timing; event/protection records; aborts; return-to-baseline and final GPU/host/BMC health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact platform BMC SDR/power-protection specification and qualified GPU vendor telemetry/workload documentation; generic ipmitool or nvidia-smi documentation defines collection mechanics, not platform limits.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never invent raw bytes or sensor order, alter power limits/fans/thresholds, clear evidence, exceed the signed power/thermal envelope, run an unapproved workload, omit channels or infer PASS from aggregate/static telemetry.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: BMC, GPU, power/thermal and lab owners approve mapping, workload, limits, any threshold/protection transition and recovery. An authorized operator supervises active loading and retains immediate abort authority.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Workload approval, protection/shutdown disposition and physical recovery remain human-controlled. Read-only inventory, synchronized telemetry, correlation, comparison and evidence packaging can be automated after inputs are approved.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On power/thermal overshoot, XID/driver/kernel fault, unexpected throttle/fan/shutdown, sensor divergence, BMC/host loss or failed recovery, stop the workload, retain safe approved cooling, preserve SEL and host/GPU logs, avoid automatic retry or evidence clearing, restore the approved baseline and quarantine the affected target pending owner disposition.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unknown `_M`/mapping, unsupported or implausible reading, missing approval/monitor/abort, wrong GPU target, limit overshoot, unexpected event/protection response, XID/ECC/driver/kernel fault, telemetry loss, BMC/host instability or failure to return to the approved baseline.

identified_defects: V2 converts missing but engineer-provisionable mapping/spec/workload inputs into automation BLOCKED.
V2 inherits an unsupported raw-IPMI prerequisite even though the source names a standard SDR read.
The source does not define `_M`, eight-channel correlation, power tolerance, workload duration or threshold-specific protection behavior.
reason_for_change: Separate presently safe SDR/GPU telemetry collection and a technically automatable attended load workflow from unresolved platform acceptance data; preserve all power, thermal, shutdown and recovery gates while removing the invented raw-command blocker.

new_technical_evidence.title: ipmitool README
new_technical_evidence.version: upstream master accessed 2026-10-13; installed version must be recorded
new_technical_evidence.supports: ipmitool can read SDR sensor values and display SEL, so generic raw bytes are not inherently required for the source's baseline observation.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The `_M` sensor semantics, scaling and platform event/protection contract remain vendor-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA System Management Interface documentation
new_technical_evidence.version: online documentation accessed 2026-10-13; installed driver/tool version must be recorded
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Supported NVIDIA GPUs only; AMD or other accelerators require their qualified equivalent
new_technical_evidence.supports: Documented GPU/module power query fields can provide independent host-side telemetry for correlation, subject to device and driver support.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: A GPU telemetry field is not proof that it measures the same rail/domain as a given BMC `_M` sensor.

removed_ambiguities: Makes `_M` and the distinct eight-channel map explicit prerequisites rather than guessed naming semantics.
Separates static read-only evidence from the prohibited active workload/threshold phase.
Defines per-channel synchronized BMC-to-host correlation without equating GPU telemetry to an unverified board rail.
resolved_blockers: Standard read-only SDR and supported host GPU actuals can be collected without vendor raw bytes; the remaining workflow is technically feasible after engineer-supplied inputs and approval.
remaining_blockers: Active loading and protection-threshold exercise remain blocked until mapping, power specifications, workload envelope, expected responses, monitoring, abort and recovery are approved.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 changes an inaccurate capability BLOCKED verdict into a gated hybrid automation contract, retains all eight `_M` targets, adds exact power-domain correlation and GPU error evidence, and does not relax any active-load or shutdown safety gate.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator preserved all eight `_M` GPU-board power channels, per-channel BMC-to-host correlation, bounded workload, protection evidence and recovery.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow only SDR/GPU baseline collection now; require a signed eight-domain map, bounded supervised workload, synchronized power telemetry and approved abort/recovery before load.
